rules.name: Chronicity: Three+ Encounters Within 12 Months
rules.rule: if(encounterCount >= 3 AND dateRange.months <= 12) then isChronicByCount = true

rules.name: Chronicity: Same Condition Over 6+ Months
rules.rule: if(dateRange >= 6 months AND sameCondition) then isChronicByTimespan = true

rules.name: Chronicity: Continuous Treatment Without Resolution
rules.rule: if(lastEncounter < TODAY - 90 days AND no-resolved-status) then isOngoing = true

rules.name: Encounters Must Fall Within Service Period
